programmes.d: The team works to solve the murder of a dog that was left a $20 million estate by its deceased owner, with the help of a wannabe detective (ANDREW DALY - The Closer).
The violent murder of an alleged rapist gives the squad the emotional task of questioning suspects. Rusty catches his mom (EVER CARRADINE) in a lie and questions her motives.
When a foreigner is murdered, the squad tries to find the killer and avoid international repercussions after a U.S. diplomat becomes involved. Rusty tries to share a secret.
After a young runaway is murdered and thrown in a trash can, the Major Crimes unit is led on a long, puzzling hunt. TOM BERENGER guest stars as Raydor's estranged husband, Jack.
After a marine widow receives a call from her dead husband, the NCIS team takes on the case and has to exhume the body to deduce whether the call was a prank or not. (TV-PG)
After being buried alive, a woman comes out of the grave with amnesia and the only thing she remembers is that there is a bomb aboard a Navy ship. (TV-PG)

When a Navy commander, who was a technical advisor to a civilian contractor creating a handheld sonar scanner, is found dead on the beach, the NCIS team investigates the murder using satellite technology. (TV-PG)
The NCIS team is called in when a severed leg bearing a marine tattoo is found in a trash bin, leading them to a small town where a murder scheme is afoot. (TV-PG)
The team investigates when a Marine recruitment officer is found shot to death by a sniper with a grudge, who leaves a white feather behind. (TV-PG)

The team investigates a murder with the help from a local sheriff, Charley, when they find out about similar murders of a Navy civilian employee and a pilot who was going through a nasty divorce. (TV-PG)
Gibbs risks his career when his former commanding officer is accused of stealing funds. (TV-PG)
A terrorist holds Ducky, Gerald and Kate hostage while the rest of the NCIS team tries to figure out how the terrorist got inside and how to get their people out safely. (TV-PG)
When the body of a marine is found after a party in an illegal night club, the team investigates a number of possible leads - including blackmail and accidental death. (TV-PG)
The team is looking for an ex-SEAL who escaped from prison in search of revenge. He is determined to find the real murderer of his wife. (TV-PG)
An NCIS agent has been murdered while investigating a case and the team's job is to find out what happened. (TV-PG)

A marine goes missing after a date with a reporter. During the investigation, the team discovers that three former members of his unit are dead and suspect the unit commander to be a serial killer. (TV-PG)
Major Crimes teams up with the LAPD's Special Operations Bureau to hunt a killer who is taking hostages. JON TENNEY, MALCOM-JAMAL WARNER, BILL BROCHTRUP, LAURIE HOLDEN guest star.

Tao finds himself doing double duty when the star of the cop show on which Tao serves as a consultant becomes the prime suspect in the murder of the star's biggest fan.
The murder of a tech entrepreneur with possible mob connections has the team working overtime. Rusty struggles to feel accepted when Raydor's son visits. JON TENNEY guest stars.
During an investigation, the LAPD finds itself in a turf battle between the Major Crimes division and the Special Operations Bureau. JON TENNEY, LAURIE HOLDEN guest star.
Major Crimes gets their hands dirty as they explore LA's underground water system. Rusty struggles to tell his biological mother (EVER CARRADINE) about his upcoming adoption.
Two people are brutally attacked at a raucous teen party and the Major Crimes unit has their hands full picking the culprit out of the crowd. DAWNN LEWIS guest stars.
A Hollywood comeback is interrupted when a former child star is found dead on skid row. Flynn's daughter (TORREY DeVITTO - Pretty Little Liars) comes to visit.
A gang banger is acquitted of murder and released from custody. Sharon's ex-husband, Jack Raydor (TOM BERENGER), represents the suspect in a subsequent murder.
Santa winds up on the naughty list after robbing a bank, but a flash mob complicates his apprehension. Sharon's kids (ZARAH MAHLER and RYAN KENNEDY) come to town for the holidays.
